content.title: AHCO Q2 Deep Dive: Capitated Deal, Segment Turnarounds, and Margin Expansion Shape 2025
content.summary: Healthcare services provider AdaptHealth Corp. (NASDAQ:AHCO) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2025, but sales were flat year on year at $800.4 million. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $3.22 billion at the midpoint came in 0.6% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.09 per share was 42.8% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
